verdict.rationale: The docs describe a full Linux environment per sandbox with shell command execution, Git operations and Docker support, and position sandboxes for building AI agents that execute code. That implies a CLI coding agent could be installed and run via exec(), but no evidence names Claude Code, Codex, or any vendor-provided recipe for running coding agents. Missing for 10: an official Claude Code/Codex recipe or guide, documented agent installation and auth/API-key setup, and hands-on corroboration of running a coding agent inside the sandbox.
